page.overview:
What is The Struggle Within?

The Struggle Within is the twelfth and last track from the 1991 album Metallica. It was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich and has a length of 3:53. It doesn't appear on any single released by Metallica.

"The Struggle Within" was written and sung during the band's last day in studio. James Hetfield had run out of steam and he has since admitted that "the struggle within" was the trouble he had coming up with the words for this song. With the benefit of hindsight, he also sees the song as indicative of the anger he was feeling at the time, and his struggle to deal with it. Said Hetfield, "I'm no psychiatrist, but it's right there."

Reaching out for something you've got to feel While clutching to what you had thought was real

Kicking at a dead horse pleases you No way of showing your gratitude So many things you don't want to do What is it? What have you got to lose?
